avoid_or_gate_when: the task is trivial or backend-only
the provider would introduce a competing PRODUCT.md or other canonical context without project approval
its expected artifact ownership conflicts with the project
another craft provider is already active for the same pass
notes: Impeccable v4 classifies new work and distinguishes Persuade, Operate, Read, and Experience.
Its context loader searches PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md plus fallback locations; integration must be compatibility-aware rather than imposing those files on every project.

avoid_or_gate_when: the project already has sufficient reproducible evidence infrastructure
Chromium/setup cost outweighs the value for a trivial task
remote origins or extra permissions are unnecessary
notes: The reviewed MCP exposes ads_render, ads_evaluate, and ads_trace.
Model judgment is opt-in; the default can return needs_human after deterministic evidence.

avoid_or_gate_when: dashboards
data tables
multi-step product UI
consequential operational workflows
another craft provider is already active for the same pass
notes: The default Taste v2 skill describes itself as experimental and contextual.
Do not inherit its style dials or stack preferences as universal project rules.

avoid_or_gate_when: the project does not already use Storybook and adding it is not independently justified
notes: Do not introduce Storybook solely to satisfy Design Pipeline when an existing browser or fixture system is adequate.

best_for: design-to-code grounding when the project already uses Figma
avoid_or_gate_when: Figma is not part of the project workflow
the task can be grounded from canonical code/runtime sources
the user has not authorized the required connected access
notes: Treat Figma as a design/context source, not proof of runtime behavior.

best_for: Stitch-assisted design workflows when already available
avoid_or_gate_when: the workflow would become dependent on an unavailable external service
another visual exploration provider already covers the task
the task has no meaningful design ambiguity
notes: Keep Stitch optional; the core pipeline must work without it.

best_for: durable project-specific visual identity and design intent
avoid_or_gate_when: using it as a pipeline configuration file
duplicating authoritative token values already owned elsewhere
copying a third-party DESIGN.md as project truth without adaptation and approval
notes: The format is still alpha; keep project usage small, prose-led, and ownership-aware.

ui-craft.reason: Useful distribution/versioning and craft-system reference, but its opinionated design doctrine and global scoring are not Design Pipeline core.

gpt-taste.reason: Useful aggressive creative influence, but too prescriptive for default automated routing.

design-intelligence-system.reason: Useful competition/human-gate/memory influence, but not mature enough to depend on.

fieldwork-design-ide.reason: Useful future evidence/control-layer influence, not a v0.1 dependency.
